obSlide1Body: Start from Home: pick a book, open units, then browse words. Use flashcards and quizzes inside each unit to study the way you like.
obSlide2Body: Open the Grammar tab below. Select one or more topics and start a session — each run uses 20 random questions with explanations.
obSlide3Body: Review uses spaced repetition for words you've practiced. Check the badge on the tab when cards are due.
obSlide4Body: Progress shows streaks and activity. Keep a steady rhythm to build a habit.
obSlide5Body: In Settings: theme, translation language (Persian / Kurdish Sorani), reminders, and more.
